description: This file defines the interface 'GenericHelper' which provides methods for managing and querying generic entity data within the Apache OFBiz framework, including CRUD operations, relation queries, and data source validation.

classes.name: GenericHelper
classes.description: Interface defining helper methods for generic entity operations such as create, find, remove, store, and data source validation within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getHelperName
methods.description: Returns the name of the server configuration associated with this helper.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new entity in the form of a GenericValue and writes it to the database.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Finds a generic entity by its primary key.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKeyPartial
methods.description: Finds a generic entity by primary key, returning only specified fields.

methods.name: findAllByPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Finds multiple entities by a list of primary keys.

methods.name: removeByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Removes an entity identified by its primary key.

methods.name: findByMultiRelation
methods.description: Finds entities related through multiple relations.

methods.name: findListIteratorByCondition
methods.description: Finds entities matching specified conditions, returning an iterator.

methods.name: storeByCondition
methods.description: Updates entities matching conditions with specified fields.

methods.name: checkDataSource
methods.description: Validates the data source against entity definitions, optionally adding missing entities or fields.
